run_regular_train: run SGD training on a sine regression task model for a fixed number of gradient steps
run_meta_train: run meta-learning training with a learnable loss model across multiple sine regression tasks
run_eval: evaluate a sine regression model on sampled tasks and return MSE and normalized MSE metrics
run_main: run the full meta-learning experiment pipeline for sine regression with configurable hyperparameters
review_meta_train: review the meta_train function that uses higher.innerloop_ctx for differentiable optimization across tasks
